title: King in Front of the Pawn
setup: Your king has marched ahead of its pawn, and Black's king is waiting on e7. The next king move decides the game.
hint: Pushing the pawn wastes the king's work. Put your king where Black's king has to give way.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Ke5}} steps in front of the pawn and takes the opposition: the kings face each other with one square between them, and Black must move. Whichever way the black king goes, yours walks past it, for example {{Kd7}} {{Kf6}}, and the pawn follows. Push the pawn first with {{e4}}, or step anywhere else, and Black takes the opposition instead: a draw.

In a king and pawn ending, the king leads and the pawn follows.
